evidence: Modifies headers presync parameter calculation and network processing in src/headerssync.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Dynamically calculating headers presync parameters eliminates manual release-time estimations while fixing a DoS modeling flaw. The PR notes that the prior offline model 'actually got it (slightly) wrong by missing the fact that attackers are capable of strategically deciding to stop the attack in the middle of a batch,' and runtime computation ensures parameters adapt automatically over time.
